χρομίον: Χρόμιος — Chromius, a Pylian captain; masc. acc. sg.
ψυχή: ψυχή — soul, life-breath, the self that leaves at death; fem. nom. sg.
ἀγαυοῦ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Τυδέος
ἀγὸς: ἀγός — leader, commander; masc. nom. sg.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀλάστορά: Ἀλάστωρ — Alastor, a Pylian companion of Nestor; masc. acc. sg., accent shifted before the enclitic τε
ἀλκῆς: ἀλκή — might, valour, prowess in battle; fem. gen. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to one another’
ἀμφιέποντες: ἀμφιέπω — be busy about, attend to, ply; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’busying themselves about’
ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
ἀντιθέῳ: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. dat. sg.
ἀπονέεσθαι: ἀπονέομαι — go back, return; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπονεῖσθαι)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Argives!’
ἀριστερὸν: ἀριστερός — left, on the left hand; masc. acc. sg., with ὦμον
ἀτρυτώνη: Ἀτρυτώνη — Atrytone, cult-title of Athena, traditionally ’the Unwearied’, though the derivation is uncertain; fem. voc. sg.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ἄμυνεν: ἀμύνω — ward off, keep off (+ acc.); impf. or aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἤμυνε, the same form in both tenses): ’warded off’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
ἄϊδι: Ἅιδης (epic also Ἄϊς) — Hades, god of the dead; dat. sg. of Ἄϊς
ἅλιον: ἅλιος — vain, to no purpose; masc. acc. sg., predicative with πόνον: ’vain’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’vain’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ · also neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (ἅλιον βέλος ’a vain shaft’) · also neut. nom. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (οὐχ ἅλιον βέλος ’not a vain shaft’)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, veil, enshroud; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented
ἐκπέρσαντ: ἐκπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐκπέρσαντ’ = ἐκπέρσαντα): ’having sacked’
ἐλθόντ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐλθόντ’ = ἐλθόντα): ’coming’
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμέθεν: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμέθεν (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’of me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’)
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice, think; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’noticed’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
ἐπιδεύεαι: ἐπιδεύομαι — lack, be in need of (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ἐόντι: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὄντι): ’being’
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἑταῖρος: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. sg.
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτά: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv., accented ἔπειτά before an enclitic (τοι)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλοιτο: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’would take, would choose’ · also aor. opt. mid. 3 sg. after μή, of fear: ’lest (he) take’ (μή τις … ἕλοιτο ’lest any take’)
ἕλωρ: ἕλωρ — prey, spoil, plunder; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’prey’
ἕνεχ: ἕνεκα — for the sake of, because of; prep. + gen., following its noun, elided and aspirated (ἕνεχ’ before a rough breathing)
ἠνίπαπε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, chide; aor. 2 3 sg., epic reduplicated (ἠνίπαπον, no Attic equivalent)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going, coming’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴφθιμον: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. acc. sg.
ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀφθαλμῶν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. gen. pl., after ἀπό: ’from the eyes’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς)
ὑσμίνην: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg.
ὑσμίνῃ: ὑσμίνη — battle, fray; fem. dat. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
ὦσε: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔωσε): ’thrust’
ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: of whom, whose; gen. pl., partitive, not the possessive
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
